scope: Seven Survival scenes for continuous Days 29–35 and twelve missing tool, technology and place plates. Reflection artwork proposals only, no reflection images generated.

images.scene: Scratching a personal comparison register beside the new marked reference staff.
images.detail: DAY 29: close three-quarter view at the uphill craft spot. He uses a small sharp unhafted flake to scratch grouped plain tally marks on a small bark slip on flat stone. A separate dry wooden reference stick has imperfectly transferred divisions and a distinguished end notch, no numerals/SI markings. Beside him a modest willow basket holds a few comparable small portions of shelled hazelnuts. Concentration tempered by worry about scarcity. Thrower and both green shafts remain outside crop. Shelter edge upper left, valley downhill right in southeast-facing view; ordinary hearth outside crop. Soft cool afternoon, no rain required.

images.scene: Inspecting the green dart's rear seat between the erratic first comparisons.
images.detail: DAY 30: after first three hand and three thrower attempts, he crouches at launch line and scratches six grouped tallies on small bark register. His expression frustrated and thoughtful. One green slender wooden dart lies horizontally on bare ground beside him, rounded BLUNT front, unfletched, rear shallow socket; one integral wooden-hook atlatl lies separately, short bark grip wrap. Ordinary spear with continuous wooden point leans beyond arm-swing space. Low camera looking WEST toward broad natural earth-bank backstop at end of a short cleared line, sparse twig markers. Open autumn scrub west/southwest of camp above tributary. NO camp shelter/fire here, no targets made of hides, no arrows, no feathers attached, no Neanderthals, no multiple darts. Focus records not a dramatic powerful throw.

images.scene: Stopping in open view with his wooden spear low while two distant figures watch from the ridge.
images.detail: DAY 31: wide view with traveller in foreground stopped on his return route, face in three-quarter profile, plain integral wooden-point spear held LOW, not pointed at anyone. He notices TWO small distant human silhouettes near ridge lookout northwest/uphill, one against pale rock. Their detailed faces not visible at this distance; compact robust upright adults in simple hide wraps, no caricature. No approaching attack, weapons clash, conversation or friendly gathering. Traveller anxious, calculating retreat, weight turned toward known route. Rugged patchy autumn valley. Nettle bundle B was placed downstream earlier and is outside picture; no fibre output. Camp furniture outside frame.
